description: settle reaches record-earn via a HARDCODED home-relative path `$HOME/anicca/skills/self/founder-loop/record-earn.mjs` (run.sh:122). Every other part of the slot resolves files via `$HERE` (the slot's own dir), so this is the only outbound assumption that the founder code repo is checked out at exactly $HOME/anicca. The spec calls out cloud portability (REQ-008 / 'no macOS-specific code'); on any instance where the repo is not at $HOME/anicca (a cloud worker, a different home layout), record-earn is 'not found' and settle silently degrades to emit settle 0 0 — i.e. earnings can never be counted there, with no error surfaced beyond a log line. TOP FIX: resolve record-earn relative to the slot (e.g. via $HERE/../../self/founder-loop/record-earn.mjs) or an explicit ANICCA_RECORD_EARN env, and make a missing recorder a loud failure rather than a silent earn-0.

evidence.snippet:
local re="$HOME/anicca/skills/self/founder-loop/record-earn.mjs"
[ -f "$re" ] || { echo "[gig] settle: record-earn not found"; emit "settle" 0 0; return; }
